chapter: The war years: Barnet, Hot Lips Page, Newton and Kirby
title: Frankie Newton's band at Cafe Society
summary: He played with Frankie Newton at Cafe Society downtown and uptown, and lists members including Vic Dickinson, Nat Jaffe and Flip Phillips.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Actually, they say after working with Ella Fitzgerald you played with Frankie Newton.
Oh!
Have we forgotten that?
Yeah, I've forgotten him. Yeah, we played the Cafe Society downtown.
Oh, that's when you were down there.
Yeah. And then we opened up Cafe Society uptown. I'll have to get you the actual dates from Barney, when the Cafe Society opened uptown.
Ramirez - 103
[END OF TAPE 3, SIDE A]
I don't think I was with Charlie quite a year, because I couldn't take that...
Before Lips Page you were with Frankie Newton at Cafe Society downtown.
Right. It must have been around that time.
Who else was in that group?
Vic Dickinson. Jumping (?). There's a picture of that in Downbeat.
There's a picture of Franz Jackson in that band.
Franz Jackson was in the band, but he left... He arranged. They had "Keep Your Shoes On, Baby" and he had a couple of arrangements in the book. But he left the band.
With (?)?
No, with Hot Lips.
Oh, he was with Hot Lips, too.
Yeah. No, Franz wasn't with the band...
He was with one of Frank's bands later. I have a picture of that, and it's not you on... Do you think were on Cafe Society Downtown Tuneups?
I don't remember all the names. Let me think... Because he opened up uptown, and he had Nat Jaffe on alto, Lou Fromm was in the band...
Ramirez - 104
Lou who?
He was with... He had Joe Filipippo(?), who later became...on clarinet, who later became a Woody Herman tenor player. What was his name?
Well, he had a lot. He had Flip Phillips.
That's the one. Before Flip Phillips, his name was Filipippo(?). He played clarinet with Frankie.
No, Flip never played anything but tenor.
No, later. But he started on clarinet with us.
Oh, that's interesting.
He could play. So... George Johnson...
Alto?
Yeah. Who were some of the other... Vic Dickinson...
